description:
## What changed

### New Features
- **MovieBox - All-In-One:** redesigned promo surfaces - paper & ink theme

The Telegram card now opens like a handwritten note: off-white paper background, ink-black serif headline ("Hey, I'm dhrubo."), letter-spaced kicker, soft body copy, the @dhrubo_moira_geche handle on a pill, a solid black *Join the channel* button and an italic *maybe later* link.

The coffee button is now a floating off-white pill pinned to the bottom-right of every screen, with a small coffee-cup illustration and the label **"Buy me a cup of coffee"** - tapping it opens supportkori.com/dhrubomorse.

Popup trigger logic, download fixes and every other patch are unchanged.
